NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 18 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 18 · 9 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 18, 10:31 AM ET

Giannis Antetokounmpo (MIA) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 18 DraftKings main slate at 59.9 DraftKings points for $11,500. Alperen Sengun (HOU, 48.8, $9,500) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 48.7, $10,000) are next.

Cam Spencer (MEM) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.93 projected points per $1,000 at $5,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 18, 10:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
